content: The current NVIDIA encode matrix identifies HEVC 4K YUV 4:4:4 as supported on Ampere and Ada NVENC, AV1 YUV 4:2:0 encode as supported on Ada but not Ampere, and defines no AV1 4:4:4 encode column. The RTX A5000 Laptop row has HEVC 4:4:4 YES and AV1 4:2:0 NO; Ada rows have both HEVC 4:4:4 and AV1 4:2:0 YES. Codec and chroma must therefore be negotiated as a coupled capability, with AV1 4:4:4 excluded. Sources: https://developer.nvidia.com/video-encode-decode-support-matrix and https://developer.nvidia.com/video-codec-sdk.
